Downloaded 2026-11-25.

Wheelchair v1, LOD1 (8,848 triangles), tevy
Source: https://tevy.dev/models/wheelchair
Original: https://tevy.dev/models/wheelchair/v1/lod1.glb
License: CC0 1.0 Universal, https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Derived OBJ preserves model geometry and normals. Original compressed GLB retained.
Original textures replaced with shared URP surface colors. Electric drive housing,
left joystick console and accent details are project additions.

Baton, Pichuliru, 2022-03-08 (302 triangles)
Source: https://poly.pizza/m/8KQCnj6CCM
Original: https://static.poly.pizza/8906055d-e5ca-4c60-a3c3-f414fc6a8f93.glb
License: Public Domain (CC0), https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Derived OBJ preserves the original model; rescaled in the prefab. Metal electrodes,
grip bands, emissive coils and animated electric arcs are project additions.

Offline conversion: tools/decode_equipment_glb.mjs and tools/convert_equipment_obj.py.
The player uses imported OBJ meshes and prefabs without GLB decoding or networking.
